_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: the cohort hazard ratio for exposure is 2

agreement.claim: both engines report the same conditional log OR (the hazard ratio estimate), its SE and the unconditional comparator
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: at most 6e-10. harness/selfcontrolled_examples.test.py finds the exact conditional MLE by Newton's method (1e-8), and over 100 cohorts shows risk-set sampling is unbiased (mean within 0.03) while cumulative sampling is biased by more than 0.15.

recovery.claim: the estimate is close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The tolerance separates the effect (0.69) from zero and from the cumulative-sampling answer (0.94). Measured by harness/selfcontrolled_examples.test.py on seeds 0 to 99.
